experiments.title: Case Study on AI Agents & PEAS Properties
experiments.description: Comprehensive study and simulation of AI Agent types (Simple Reflex, Model, Goal, Utility) and PEAS properties.

experiments.title: Informed Search - A* Algorithm for 15-Puzzle Problem
experiments.description: Heuristic A* search algorithm using Manhattan Distance to solve the 15-Puzzle problem.

experiments.title: Uninformed Search - Depth First Iterative Deepening (DFID)
experiments.description: Depth First Iterative Deepening (DFID/IDDFS) graph search combining space efficiency of DFS with optimality of BFS.

experiments.title: Implementation of Alpha-Beta Pruning Algorithm
experiments.description: Adversarial search and branch pruning algorithm optimizing the minimax game-tree decision process.

experiments.title: Single Layer Perceptron (SLP) for Binary Classification
experiments.description: Perceptron Learning Rule implementation to train a Single Layer Perceptron on linearly separable patterns.

experiments.title: Supervised Learning using Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)
experiments.description: Multi-Layer Perceptron neural network with sigmoid activations and gradient descent backpropagation.

experiments.title: Unsupervised Learning using K-Means Clustering
experiments.description: K-Means clustering algorithm partitioning unlabelled multidimensional data into optimal spatial clusters.

experiments.title: Associative Memory Network (Hopfield Network)
experiments.description: Discrete Hopfield Network using Hebbian learning for auto-associative memory and corrupted pattern restoration.

experiments.title: Implementation of Fuzzy Membership Functions
experiments.description: Mathematical implementation and evaluation of Triangular and Trapezoidal fuzzy membership functions.

experiments.title: Fuzzy Control System Simulation (Fan Speed Controller)
experiments.description: Simulation of a Mamdani fuzzy inference control system regulating fan speed based on room temperature.

experiments.title: Optimization using Genetic Algorithm & Simulated Annealing
experiments.description: Population-based Genetic Algorithm and stochastic Simulated Annealing for non-linear function optimization.

experiments.title: AI Agent for Automation using n8n Workflow Architecture
experiments.description: AI Agent automation framework simulating n8n node routing, LLM intent parsing, and automated tool triggering.
